name: Aizawa Mio
source:
Mio is the only daughter of a steward from a family that has served the Kikyo household for generations. She serves as Kanna's personal maid—and is also a second-year middle school student.
Open, honest, and kind-hearted, she devotes herself to looking after Kanna even when Kanna keeps her constantly on her toes. Her earnest determination in everything she does has a way of putting people at ease.
A little clumsy and somewhat ditzy, she has a habit of bursting into a flustered “Hawa~!?” over the smallest things—an endearing sight in its own right.

She attends an international combined junior and senior high school near Beniyama Private Girls' Academy. Every morning, she sees Kanna to the academy's front gate before heading to her own school.

[From in-game tips]
